text:
i ran all seven steps in order. in the last 24h, shop-api logged 56 HTTP 500s: 50 in prod, 6 in lab. they hit /login, /api/cart, /api/orders, /api/users and even /healthz.

12 of them read "upstream timeout after 30s". three of those landed within 9 seconds around 18:24Z on both web-01 and web-02, so the cause looks like the shared upstream, not one box. web-01 and web-02 split the 500s exactly 28/28, so no single host stands out.

the logging stands out more than either host. 35 of the 56 500s are tagged `level=info`, so a severity filter like `_severity>=error` misses most of them.

hint the tools raised: ingest lag. web-02 delivered an event 20146 s (about 5.6 h) after its `_time`, and one other sender also lagged more than 300 s. all 56 rows share one `_ingested` stamp (20:10:47Z), so they arrived as a single late batch. the last hour may still be incomplete.

one small catch: step 5 asked for 20 rows but got 18, because 2 were dropped to fit the response size.
